# Cleanse.ng — Professional House Cleaning in Ibadan

> Cleanse.ng is a managed residential cleaning service in Ibadan, Nigeria. Customers book online; Cleanse assigns a vetted, trained cleaner, provides all supplies, and a supervisor oversees every visit. Cleanse remains responsible for the service from booking to completion.

Cleanse offers regular (routine) cleaning, deep cleaning, move-in/move-out cleaning, and post-fumigation cleaning for homes of 1–5 bedrooms. Pricing is flat and upfront by home size, with one-time visits or managed monthly plans (twice a week). Service area: Ibadan, Oyo State — including Bodija, Oluyole, Akobo, Iyaganku, Jericho, the GRA, and the University of Ibadan area.

## Key facts
- Business: Cleanse.ng (residential house cleaning service)
- Location: Ibadan, Oyo State, Nigeria
- Service model: fully managed — vetted cleaners, supplies included, dedicated supervisor per visit
- Booking: online at https://cleanse.ng, or WhatsApp +234 913 066 3739
- Hours: 8am–6pm daily
- Pricing (per visit): 1BR ₦15,000 · 2BR ₦20,000 · 3BR ₦25,000 · 4BR ₦30,000 · 5BR ₦40,000. Monthly plans (twice a week) from ₦60,000/month.

## Services
- [Cleaning Services in Ibadan (overview)](https://cleanse.ng/cleaning-services-ibadan): all services, areas, pricing and FAQ.
- Regular cleaning: routine upkeep to keep a home consistently maintained.
- Deep cleaning: intensive, top-to-bottom clean.
- Move-in / move-out cleaning: detailed end-of-tenancy clean.
- Post-fumigation cleaning: full reset after fumigation.
